analogy.rationale: Cannabinoid receptors (CNR1/CNR2) are G protein-coupled receptors with low expression in most of these cell lines, so antagonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other cannabinoid receptor ligands and GPCR antagonists, which similarly act on poorly expressed receptors.
